entries.title: Home — USA map of all stations
entries.text: The HydroTwin home page: a map of the USA with every station. Hover a pin for basin information, click a pin to open that station.

entries.title: How to change the date
entries.text: Use the Date field at the top left of a station page. Pick any date from 2001-10-01 to 2026-09-30; the scene, hydrograph, forecasts and (on 3D pages) the rain or snow animation all follow the selected day.

entries.title: How to switch between Data view, 3D view, Ground and Table
entries.text: Each station has a Data view page (statistics) and a 3D page; the link at the top of each page switches between them. On the 3D page, the layer view button switches the scene between Ground (real terrain) and Table (tabletop model).

entries.title: How to open a panel
entries.text: Panels load on click only. On a Data view page use the PANELS bar above the sections; on a 3D page use the PANELS bar at the bottom left. Click a panel name to open it, click again to close it.

entries.title: Rain and snow animation
entries.text: On a 3D station page, pick a date in the Date field: if that day had rain at the station, animated rain falls in the scene; if it had snow, animated snowfall; dry days show neither. The amount comes from the Open-Meteo archive for that day.
